data.heading: How to keep your hair color looking fresh
data.body:
A new color always looks great when you leave the salon. These general tips can help it last.

  • Wait a day or two before washing after a color appointment, unless your stylist says otherwise.
  • Use a shampoo and conditioner made for colored hair.
  • Wash with lukewarm water rather than hot.
  • Protect your hair from strong sun when you can.
  • Use heat protection before styling with hot tools.

Swimming pools and the sea can also affect color, so rinse your hair with fresh water after a swim and use a conditioner.

Every hair type is different, so ask your stylist what will suit you best. They can recommend products and a care routine for your hair.

Booking your next appointment before you leave helps you keep your color looking its best, and makes sure you get a time that suits you.

If your color isn't quite what you expected, let us know. We'd much rather hear from you than have you leave unhappy.

data.heading: Five ways to make the most of your salon visit
data.body:
A salon visit should feel like a treat. These tips help you get exactly what you want.

Bring photos. Pictures of styles you like, and don't like, are the quickest way to explain what you have in mind.

Be honest about your routine. If you only have five minutes in the morning, tell your stylist so they can suggest a style that works for you.

Mention anything important, such as sensitive skin or recent treatments elsewhere.

Ask questions. Your stylist or therapist is happy to share tips for looking after your hair, skin or nails at home.

After your visit, tell us how it went. If something isn't quite right, we'd rather fix it than have you leave unhappy.

And if you loved it, booking your next appointment before you leave gives you the best choice of times.

Finally, relax. Put your phone away, enjoy the moment and let us look after you.

We look forward to welcoming you to [Your Business Name].
